utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely — folks are starting to drop off tools and spare parts already. If you’re heading over, I can fill you in on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that so? What exactly do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly hand tools, a couple of extension cords, and any spare screws or nails people can part with. I can check the list for the bigger items if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan around the block so everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. Thanks, Vik; keep me posted and I’ll spread the word when I catch people.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep looping the repair drive plan around the block and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the first repair on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d start with the leaky sink in Mrs. Patel’s place—it’s been giving her trouble all week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the sink first and see what parts we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re running low on screws, duct tape, and a couple hand tools. If you can bring any of that, it’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring screws and duct tape by later today, and I’ll check for a couple hand tools too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, so just tell me what time the repair drive is. Then I’ll see what fits best for pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — we’re aiming for Saturday morning, around 9 to noon. I’ll confirm the exact time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — just send the exact time when you have it, and I’ll plan pickup around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can do that—first I’ll sort the list of repairs, then we’ll pick a start time and hand out the jobs. I’m just a bit foggy, so if you’ve got the priorities, tell me and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with the urgent fixes first, then the smaller jobs after that. I’m free tomorrow morning, so if that works, we can hand out the tasks then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Want me to invite a few more neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please do — and maybe keep it to the closest neighbors first so we can manage the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the closest neighbors and keep it manageable. I’ll let you know who I invite so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re putting together a list of homes and fixes this week, then I’ll match folks with volunteers and supplies. If you know anyone who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll pass along anyone I hear about. Thanks, Rosa; I’m only catching things second-hand, so I appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for organizing the repair drive, Mara. What details do you want me to double-check first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you double-check the tool sign-out list first, then the volunteer time slots? That’ll help me make sure everyone has what they need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll check the tool sign-out list first and then the volunteer time slots.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep things simple right now. Let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — simple is perfect. I’ll swing by late and help with whatever’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Dane. Just text me when you’re on your way, and I’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — what tools do you have available?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hammer, a screwdriver set, and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive details—where should we meet, and what location are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s meet at my place first, then head over to the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—your place first, then the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over the tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’d really appreciate that—I'll let you know what time works.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush—just text me when you’ve got a time, and I’ll swing by with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and drop-off details. Do we know where the repair drive is and what they’ll actually accept?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—have they confirmed the location and accepted items? If you want, I can check before we go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—if you can check the location and what they’ll take, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — we still need a couple more volunteers and a few people to bring tools. I’m checking the sign-up list now, and I’ll send you the gaps once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send me the gaps and I’ll help fill them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we have and what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me the list, and I’ll help track the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late, but I can bring the list by and help check off what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane—bring it by when you can and we’ll go through it together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands for the repair drive. I can swing by later and see what’s left to do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that’d be a huge help—thank you. If you stop by later, I can point you to the easiest jobs and the school schedule details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll stop by later and grab one of the easy jobs. Just point me to the schedule when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep it quick and just tell me what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — we need a few volunteers, a simple sign-up sheet, and any donated tools or supplies folks can spare. I’ll keep it organized and let you know the exact list right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort donations and carry boxes. What’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — let’s sort the donations by type and size first, then we can load the boxes together. I’ll get us started at the driveway around 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—I'll spread the word right away. Everyone on the block should know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for what folks say.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll mention it to everyone I see, and I’ll let you know if anyone has questions or wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be a big help, Opal. If you can keep the locations straight, I’ll make a simple plan for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep a clear list of each repair drive location and let you know which spots are next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — what time is the repair drive, and do you need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I want to double-check the details before I say for sure, but I can confirm the time and let you know if I need help setting up soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve confirmed the time, and I can help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I'll keep an ear out while I'm running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira—that’d be a huge help. I’ll make sure the details are posted clearly so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and point people to the posted details if they ask. Hope we get a good turnout.
